title: Neutrino Domain Corpus Manifest
description: Declares the source corpus an AI-assisted domain analysis is allowed to read, with per-source ownership, sensitivity, allowed-use policy, content hash, and source type. Fail-closed (additionalProperties:false). Validated by scripts/corpus/validate_domain_proposal.py. See docs/domains/DOMAIN_PROPOSAL.md and TRANSLATOR_IMPLEMENTATION_PHASES Phase 22A.

allowedUse.description: domain-authority: may justify accepted domain logic. reference-only: context, not authority. excluded: must not be used.

artifactCoordinates.description: e.g. Maven GAV for an SDK-derived source.

licenseApproved.description: Explicit license review outcome. Required true for a decompiled-binary source.
